item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
For the East Delaware Tunnel Outlet (EDTO) Emergency Reconstruction, located in the Delaware System and discharges water from Pepacton Reservoir via the East Delaware Tunnel into Rondout Reservoir. The project is intended to design and manage construction of repairs to the EDTO structure, including demolition and replacement of the Bypass Stilling Chamber and repairs to the Upper Chamber.

item.title: Fire Department — Procurement: Airway Management and Hemorrhage Control Training Manikins
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Procurement of medical training manikins and task trainers, including Airway Plus Lifecast units with pulse and breathing features (models APL-PB2 and APL-PB2-AA), a hemorrhage control classroom trainer and a tourniquet application training arm with integrated blood fill system. The tourniquet trainer includes a full arm with hand, blood fill syringe, and quick start guide, designed to support realistic hands-on emergency response and bleeding control training.

item.description:
Outcome: Procurement

Naturally Occurring Retirement Communities (NORCs) provide an outlet aimed at socialization for community-dwelling older adults and prevent them from being isolated and disenfranchised. Residents engage in various programs to receive case management or assistance for help with social services, speak with a healthcare professional on issues of concern, participate in health and wellness activities, learn ways to better manage chronic health conditions, and to enjoy an educational or recreational afternoon with neighbors.
